stories.title: 9/11 victim Barbara Keating laid to rest 25 years after attack
stories.summary: The remains of Barbara Keating, a passenger on American Airlines Flight 11 killed on 9/11, were finally identified and she is being laid to rest 25 years later. Her burial underscores that more than 1,100 people killed in New York still have unverified remains.

stories.title: Cargo ship fire at Chinese shipyard in Qingdao kills 25
stories.summary: At least 25 people died when fire engulfed a foreign cargo vessel undergoing repairs at a state-owned yard in Qingdao, east China's Shandong province, with five more injured. The blaze at one of China's busiest ports highlights persistent risks in ship-repair operations.

stories.title: Houthis advance on Red Sea coast, threatening Bab al-Mandeb
stories.summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels are rapidly advancing along Yemen's Red Sea coast, threatening leverage over the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, a vital global trade route, while Saudi Arabia launched about 40 strikes in a new salvo after Houthi attacks on its oil facilities. The escalation imperils one of the world's key shipping chokepoints.

stories.title: Positron AI raises $875M at $5B valuation for inference chips
stories.summary: AI inference-chip startup Positron AI raised $875 million in a Series C at a $5 billion post-money valuation to scale its memory-first inference silicon. The round signals investor appetite for hardware that makes serving AI models cheaper and more efficient as inference becomes a distinct battleground from training.

stories.title: 5 Browns players to know for Week 1 vs. Jaguars
stories.summary: Jared Verse, acquired from the Rams in the Myles Garrett trade, headlines five Browns players to watch in Sunday's season opener against the Jaguars after recording 100 pressures last year. The list previews the roster pieces Cleveland will lean on in Week 1.

stories.title: 3 keys for the Browns to beat the Jaguars in Week 1
stories.summary: A film-room breakdown lays out three keys for the Browns to beat the Jaguars on Sunday, leaning on cornerbacks Denzel Ward, Tyson Campbell and Myles Harden to bend without breaking and force Jacksonville to run. Cleveland opens the season on the road.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Texas: which team has the edge at each position
stories.summary: CBS Sports breaks down where No. 1 Ohio State and No. 4 Texas hold the edge at each position ahead of Saturday's marquee Week 2 showdown in Austin. The result tests the Buckeyes' top-ranked status on the road against the most anticipated nonconference game of the season.

stories.title: College football Week 2 picks: Texas vs. Ohio State
stories.summary: USA Today's experts make picks for Week 2, headlined by No. 1 Ohio State visiting No. 4 Texas in a game carrying Big Ten-versus-SEC weight. Several prognosticators lean toward Texas in the primetime clash.

stories.title: Spanish GP Thursday press conference opens Madrid weekend
stories.summary: Drivers including Fernando Alonso and Carlos Sainz spoke in Madrid at Thursday's Spanish Grand Prix press conference ahead of F1's second race in Spain, held at the new Madring circuit this weekend. The 11-13 September round replaces Imola and kicks off the team's second visit to the country this season.

stories.title: Bexley Mayor Ben Kessler to resign after 14 years
stories.summary: Bexley Mayor Ben Kessler, first elected in 2012, announced he will resign September 30 to work on regional housing efforts with Columbus, ending a 14-year tenure. City council will select his successor.
